data.description:
## Context / Problem
plan_review_precheck runs the deterministic floor before the LLM passes, but only a P8 too-big block short-circuits; the code states "A P1/P5 DET block does NOT stop the LLM" (src/rebar/llm/plan_review/workflow_ops.py:208-215). A plan that fails the blocking clarity floor (P1) therefore pays the full four-pass LLM review it is guaranteed to fail.

## Approach
Widen the existing P8 short-circuit branch (workflow_ops.py:216-239 and the matching decision in src/rebar/llm/workflow/gate_dispatch.py:436) from "P8 blocked" to "any DET gate produced a blocking finding", reusing the same partition_findings/finalize_verdict path so the BLOCK verdict carries the DET findings with coverage.llm_ran=False. Alternative rejected: adding a content check to claimability.py — that seam is deliberately status-only (no plan-content checks) and reusing it would blur the fast-fail contract.

## Scope
src/rebar/llm/plan_review/workflow_ops.py, src/rebar/llm/workflow/gate_dispatch.py, tests/llm/test_det_short_circuit.py.

## Testing
Unit with FakeRunner: a plan with no `## Acceptance Criteria` checklist (P1 block) yields BLOCK with zero runner invocations; a DET-clean plan runs the LLM passes exactly as before; the emitted verdict carries the DET blocking findings and standard remediation text.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Any DET-floor blocking finding yields a BLOCK verdict with coverage.llm_ran False and zero runner invocations (checked: unit test with FakeRunner).
- [ ] DET-clean plans run the full LLM passes unchanged (checked: existing plan-review workflow tests pass unmodified).
- [ ] The short-circuit verdict includes every DET blocking finding (checked: unit test asserts finding ids present).
data.title: Short-circuit the plan review before any LLM pass on a DET-floor block
